title: Introduction to Probability and Descriptive Statistics
description: Fundamental concepts of probability, frequency distributions, central tendencies, and variance in official statistics.

title: Applied Statistical Inference and Hypothesis Testing
description: Techniques of parametric and non-parametric hypothesis testing, p-values, z-tests, and t-tests for government surveys.

title: Advanced Mathematical Statistics and Multivariate Theory
description: Multivariate distributions, maximum likelihood estimation, Bayesian inference, and advanced estimation theory.

title: Fundamentals of Socio-Economic Survey Questionnaire Design
description: Crafting structured questionnaire schedules, field trial methodology, avoiding leading inquiries, and enumerator manuals.

title: Digital Field Data Collection and CAPI Systems
description: Computer Assisted Personal Interviewing (CAPI) workflow, validation rule programming, and real-time field data monitoring.

title: National Survey Strategy and Methodological Frameworks
description: Strategic planning of pan-India socio-economic surveys, non-sampling error modeling, and longitudinal survey structuring.

title: Basic Sampling Techniques and Frame Selection
description: Simple random sampling with and without replacement, systematic sampling, and sample frame construction from census data.

title: Stratified and Multi-Stage Cluster Sampling in Practice
description: Allocation formulas for stratified sampling, primary sampling unit (PSU) selection, design effects, and sampling weights.

title: Small Area Estimation and Complex Survey Error Estimation
description: Fay-Herriot models, synthetic estimation, linearization, and jackknife replication for complex multi-stage surveys.

title: Data Validation and Tabulation Basics
description: Manual checking, sanity ranges, syntax errors, and primary validation rules for raw field data files.

title: Automated Survey Data Auditing and Anomaly Detection
description: Detecting systematic anomalies, duplicate respondents, logic discrepancies, and automated schema conformance testing.

title: Advanced Imputation and Missing Data Methodologies
description: Multiple imputation by chained equations (MICE), hot-deck imputation, cold-deck imputation, and missingness pattern modeling.

title: SQL for Public Sector Data Management
description: Relational database concepts, writing SELECT queries, filtering, sorting, and fundamental table joins.

title: Intermediate SQL: Aggregations, Grouping and Subqueries
description: Multi-table relational joins, GROUP BY aggregations, HAVING clauses, nested subqueries, and indexing strategies.

title: Advanced Analytical SQL and Window Functions
description: Window functions (ROW_NUMBER, RANK, LAG, LEAD), Common Table Expressions (CTEs), recursive queries, and query performance tuning.

title: Python Scripting Fundamentals for Data Processing
description: Python syntax, lists, dictionaries, functions, file I/O operations, and basic CSV handling for statistical officers.

title: Data Manipulation and Analysis with Pandas and NumPy
description: Vectorized computations, DataFrame operations, grouping, merging, pivot tables, and handling dates and times with Pandas.

title: Building Production Data Pipelines in Python
description: Object-oriented scripting, automated ETL pipelines, error handling, batch processing, and modular Python packaging.

title: Effective Data Presentation and Chart Selection
description: Choosing appropriate charts, color theory, visual hierarchy, and creating clear graphics for government reports.

title: Statistical Graphics with Matplotlib and Seaborn
description: Distribution plots, heatmaps, boxplots, multi-faceted plots, and publication-ready statistical figure export in Python.

title: Building Executive Dashboards with Power BI and Tableau
description: Interactive KPIs, drill-through reports, geospatial mapping, and automated dashboard refreshes for decision-makers.

title: Linear and Logistic Regression Modeling
description: Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) regression, coefficient interpretation, assumptions checking, and binary logistic regression.

title: Time Series Analysis and ARIMA Forecasting
description: Stationarity testing, autocorrelation and partial autocorrelation, seasonal ARIMA models, and economic forecasting.

title: Macroeconomic Econometric Modeling and VAR Systems
description: Vector Autoregression (VAR), cointegration, error-correction models, and structural macroeconomic simulation.

title: Overview of National Accounts and Macroeconomic Aggregates
description: Introduction to the System of National Accounts (SNA), concept of Gross Value Added (GVA), and Gross Domestic Product (GDP).

title: Sectoral Value Added and Supply-Use Tables (SUT)
description: Industry classification methodologies, intermediate consumption estimation, deflation, and compiling Supply and Use Tables.

title: Institutional Sector Accounts and Capital Finance Compilation
description: Financial accounts, sequence of accounts for financial and non-financial corporations, government finance statistics, and rest of world.

title: Structured Writing for Statistical Bulletins
description: Key principles of clarity, audience adaptation, writing executive summaries, and explaining statistical indicators concisely.

title: Policy Brief Formulation and Statistical Storytelling
description: Translating data insights into policy recommendations, writing impact notes for ministries, and press release drafting.

title: Authoring National Statistical Yearbooks and Dissemination Reports
description: Managing multi-author reporting projects, technical documentation, metadata standards, and international reporting commitments.

title: Data Protection Principles and Ethical Information Handling
description: Introduction to the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, respondent confidentiality, and data handling ethics.

title: Statistical Disclosure Control and Anonymization Techniques
description: k-anonymity, l-diversity, cell suppression, perturbation, and releasing public microdata without compromising privacy.

title: Enterprise Data Governance Frameworks and Compliance Audit
description: Designing agency-wide data access protocols, metadata stewardship, audit logging, and cross-departmental data sharing rules.

title: Introduction to Predictive Modeling and Supervised Learning
description: Foundations of machine learning, classification vs regression, decision trees, k-nearest neighbors, and train/test splits.

title: Scikit-Learn Workflows and Model Evaluation in Python
description: Cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning, ROC-AUC, confusion matrices, Random Forests, and Gradient Boosting algorithms.

title: Unsupervised Learning, Clustering and Dimensionality Reduction
description: K-Means clustering, hierarchical clustering, Principal Component Analysis (PCA), t-SNE, and feature selection pipelines.
